The '''Anaxsi''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] residents of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. They were fervently loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the planet was one large [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] training and staging ground.

==History==
The Anaxsi were members of the [[Azure Imperium]] and Anaxes was the chief shipyard and fortress. Proud for their planet's prestige in naval tradition, the Anaxsi had closed social circles, and accepted outsiders only established experts in naval service.<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Anaxsi showed such loyalty to the Empire that hostility existed towards the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The Anaxsi had a strong inclination toward naval duty and therefore were among the strongest supporters of the Imperial Navy until eventually being one of the last [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] planets to fall to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
